label: Get on Board
terms_note: Public read endpoints keyless; docs page JS-only so terms/limits not read.

discovery.auth: none for public reads (token for authenticated endpoints)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** for search (public JSON:API v0). Lane `assist` → **api for search**. Confidence medium (docs JS-only; endpoints live).

endpoints.notes: data[]: id (slug), attributes title, description_headline, description, …

reference.limits: - Terms / rate limits not readable (JS docs).

search_postings.note: Public API ('No authentication required'): GET /api/v0/search/jobs with query, remote, page ('starting at 1') and per_page (maximum 120); expand=["company"] is sent so the company name is inline. country_code takes alpha-3 codes (example 'CHL') and there is no free-text place filter, so location and country are not sent. JSON:API hits: id is the job slug, attributes.description is HTML, attributes.published_at is a Unix epoch integer (raw), min/max_salary are integers with no documented currency, meta.total_pages is the only count (no total). Mirrors jobs/getonbrd (remote is not a deals input, so it is not sent); buyer is the expanded company name, min/max_salary map to budget_min/max.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: No per-id endpoint is documented; the feed returns whole records.
not_offered.submit_bid: No application or bid API is documented; candidates apply on the posting's public_url.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
